verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's docs publish 96 GB of GDDR7 and explicitly pitch running and fine-tuning LLMs locally. They also cite a second-generation FP8 Transformer Engine for LLM inference, and 96 GB is enough capacity for a quantized 70B-class model on a single card. Community hands-on reports show these cards running LLM inference at high token throughput, but one user notes SM120 lacks support in major libraries, which tempers how practical inference is. Missing for 10: a published memory-bandwidth figure (docs only say 'ultra-fast GDDR7' and give PCIe Gen 5 bandwidth), an explicit 70B-class model demonstration or benchmark on a single card, and confirmation of mature inference-library support for SM120.
